zero_work_and_administrative_history.reason: Waited without starting; original external Q_plus failure later retained. No r3 reserved compute used.
Administrative concurrency-4 handoff; Q_minus remained active under original r5 host and is counted once.
Administrative single-GPU change preparation; no development worker launched.
User cancelled single-GPU2 change; undeployed draft has no new worker/compute. Original updates were not interrupted.
CUDA resource query OOM before true model loader; spent worker time retained once; no training-interval allowance spent.

limitations: Generation and training compute are distinct costs; no currency price or total CPU core-hours were measured.
Three historical interrupted training intervals and partial backward rows retain upper/lower accounting; successful recovery does not make the old attempts successful.
Waiting supervisors with no launched GPU worker add wall-clock delay but zero worker GPU seconds.
All intervals use historical host process accounting; they are not hardware utilization integrals.

provenance.scope: Read-only JSON/protocol provenance review; no .pt loading, model calls, tokenizer, tests, acceptance, training or production edits. Science metrics/cost aggregation owned separately.

protocol_amendments: Original first-slot export error was rematerialized read-only; its formal outcome was retained, not regenerated.
Interrupted Q computations were discarded and explicitly reauthorized from the same full S_star; old unknown rows and costs remain.
The original per-Q cumulative 48-hour limit was replaced by an amended allocation inside the unchanged total 144-hour training budget.
GPU capacity and concurrency rules changed with explicit user authorization; original numerical H1, samples, direction and final evaluation contract were retained.
A later GPU2-only proposal was cancelled before deployment; the restored final host used GPUs 0-7 with a four-resident cap.
limitations: One training window; four manually authored development roots and two paired seeds each; no independent confirmation or population inference.
The selected positive direction raises local_lineage_delivery and lowers evidenced_peer_product_delivery only within LA/member_001; this is not a general collaboration intervention.
Formal failure with partial credit is distinct from unknown. All56 joint/token outcomes and generation cost are known here.
